title: Desly — Manageable menus and editable checkout sections
summary: Customization of the Desly e-commerce with editable menus and sections, configurable landing pages, and manageable checkout blocks without touching code.
context: An education-sector client on Magento who needed to give the in-house team control over menus, landings, and key checkout sections without depending on a developer for every change. The challenge was to expose editable blocks without breaking the native Magento 2 module architecture.
challenges: Let the in-house team edit navigation menus without touching the repository.
Build a header configurable per category or season.
Enable landing pages with reusable drag-and-drop blocks.
Expose checkout sections that marketing could tune without redeploys.
approach: Magento 2 with CMS blocks and widgets, nested per category and per page.
Slot-based configurable header with empty-slot fallback.
Landing pages built from reusable blocks (CMS + layout XML per route).
Checkout sections wrapped in editable blocks while keeping the native module contracts.
outcomes: Menus editable by the in-house team without code changes.
Configurable header that switches between catalog sections without redeploy.
Reusable landing pages ready for short campaigns.
Checkout sections adjustable in content without affecting business logic.
Final screenshots and metrics pending validation before publishing.
